# SpilloverAI Research Log

## Project Title
Predicting Zoonotic Spillover Risk Using Multi-Source Geospatial Data and Machine Learning: A Case Study of Kyasanur Forest Disease in the Western Ghats

---

## Version
Research Version 1.0

---

## Research Question

Can satellite-derived environmental variables and climate indicators predict Kyasanur Forest Disease outbreaks in the Western Ghats?

---

## Study Area

Western Ghats, India

States:
- Karnataka
- Kerala
- Goa
- Maharashtra

Time Period:
2015–2024

---

## Decisions

### Decision 1

Target disease:
Kyasanur Forest Disease (KFD)

Reason:
Environmentally sensitive disease with documented surveillance records.
